name: Peter Van Gaasbeck
bio: A Representative from New York; born in Ulster County, N.Y., September 27, 1754; attended the grammar schools; became a man of prominence in the county and state; engaged in mercantile pursuits in Kingston, N.Y.; served in the Revolutionary War, captain and major in the Ulster County, N.Y., Militia; elected as a Pro-Administration candidate to the Third Congress (March 4, 1793-March 3, 1795); died in 1797, Kingston, N.Y.; interment in First Reformed Dutch Churchyard, Kingston, N.Y.
